changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 4c item 1: extracted resolveConfig (the provider-loading + mergeWithDefaults tail of config.ts's readConfigFile, deliberately excluding plugins[] loading) as an exported function, and readConfigFile itself, for the Config Service to reuse on open and on config.agents.replace instead of duplicating the file-open sequence; readConfigFile's return now also carries the parsed raw object. Folded loadOrInitConfig's local atomicWriteIfAbsent onto dreamux-utils's existing publishFileExclusive. loadConfig/loadOrInitConfig keep their exact external behavior and return shapes.
